Ishaan R: Hey folks, I booked team lodging for a 4-person client trip on the company card. One teammate (Leah) left one day early and we agreed she'd pay her night back. Hotel gave a single folio and only emailed a receipt after checkout that shows all nights together. How do I split the charge and what evidence does Leah need to reimburse? Booking REF: H3452
Leah M: I left due to family emergency and paid cash at checkout for my last night but lost the small paper receipt. I have my bank ATM withdrawal showing cash taken and a photo of the hotel desk note that shows I paid cash. Will that work?
Jordan (People Ops): Short answer: we prefer an itemized hotel folio and a proof of payment from the employee. If the hotel cannot provide an itemized paid receipt for Leah's night, Finance can accept a signed employee attestation plus supporting evidence (photo of desk note + ATM withdrawal) for amounts under $200.
Finance Bot: Policy excerpt: When a personal night is paid by an employee after a company card charge, reimbursement can be handled via either 1) hotel refund to company card with folio adjustment or 2) employee repayment. For repayments under $200, acceptable documentation includes (a) itemized folio, (b) employee-signed attestation, (c) proof of payment (card/cash withdrawal + staff note). Amounts >= $200 require hotel refund or manager escalation.
Ishaan R: The amount is $158. Hotel says their system only issues a full folio and not per-night reprints unless we request. I asked them; they said they'd email a payment confirmation for the cash transaction but it might take 48 hours.
Expense Bot: Reminder: please do not create a negative expense line. Create two expense lines: 1) Hotel - Business nights (company card) 2) Employee reimbursement - Leah (personal). Attach all docs and use tag "hotel-split".
Leah M: I can sign an attestation form. What should it say?
Jordan (People Ops): Attestation should be a short statement: "I, Leah M, confirm I paid the hotel $158 in cash for the night of 2025-02-17 (folio H3452) and request reimbursement to the company for my personal charge." Include date, signature (typed name is fine) and list attached evidence (photo of desk note, ATM withdrawal showing cash). Upload that with the expense and ask Ishaan to mark payment method as "Employee Reimbursement - Leah" on the hotel's split line.
Finance Bot: Once uploaded, Finance will validate. Automated rules: if employee attestation + photo of hotel note + ATM withdrawal present, the claim will move to manual review and typically approve within 48 business hours. If hotel confirmation arrives showing a refund to company card before processing, Finance will instead apply the refund and no reimbursement needed.
Travel Desk (Amelia): For future group bookings, please try to book separate room folios where possible or ask front desk at check-in to split rooms per payer. That avoids this friction. Also cc travel@redwood.com if you make on-the-spot changes so we can help get itemized receipts.
Ishaan R: Thanks — I've uploaded the signed attestation (leah_attest.pdf), photo_hotel_note.jpg, atm_withdrawal.png, and the combined folio. Marked Leah's line as "Employee Reimbursement" in Expensify with comment "Leah paid cash - attestation attached".
Finance Bot: Received. Automated check: amount $158 < $200, attestation + evidence present. Flagging for manual review. Expected action: approve reimbursement and mark company folio as reconciled. Processing TAT ~2 business days.
Leah M: Appreciate it, thanks everyone. I'll follow up if hotel confirmation email comes in.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks all. Will file a short note in the travel audit: "group_folio_split - exception handled" to assist future audits.
Ishaan R: Noted — and I'll remind front desk to split next time.
